name: benchmark-nanoclimatefever
description: A small benchmark focused on climate-related claim verification (nano Climate FEVER): given short claims or statements about climate topics, models must assess/verdict whether claims are supported, refuted, or not enough information, potentially with supporting evidence. It evaluates factual correctness and domain-specific reasoning on climate science claims.
evaluation_method: accuracy / F1 (standard fact verification scoring; FEVER-style metrics)
reputation: A niche, domain-specific variant of FEVER with limited community adoption and usage.
